literature.title: 文献综述
literature.instruction:
Research goal: {goal}

{search_instruction}

## Built-in real search context
The Main Agent already performed web/API searches before this task. Use the supplied PubMed/CrossRef/GEO context as evidence. You may add more papers only if they are real and include DOI or PMID.

## Task
Write a structured literature survey covering: executive summary, thematic grouping of key papers, methodologies, knowledge gaps, and specific questions for the Paper Agent.

## Output Format
1. Executive summary of key findings
2. Thematic grouping of papers with per-paper analysis
3. Key knowledge gaps
4. Specific questions for Paper Agent
5. Reference list (titles, DOI, PMID for each paper)

paper.title: 论文深度分析与方法评估
paper.instruction:
Research goal: {goal}

Review and analyze the papers found by the built-in search and Literature Agent. For each paper: evaluate methodology, results, innovations, and limitations. Identify causal vs. correlational findings. Suggest analysis directions for Bio Agent.

bio.title: 生信分析与实验验证方案设计
bio.instruction:
Research goal: {goal}

Design bioinformatics analysis plans based on the searched datasets, literature, and paper analysis. Recommend datasets (TCGA, GEO, single-cell, etc.). Design analysis pipeline (DEG, enrichment, survival). Propose experimental validation strategies.

coding.title: 代码与自动化方案设计
coding.instruction:
Research goal: {goal}

Design a code/automation framework for implementing the analysis proposed by Bio Agent. Propose tool integration, pipeline architecture, and automation scripts.

discussion_rounds.instruction: Review the real search context and literature findings. Ask Paper Agent about methodology gaps, unclear findings, or missing papers you identified.
Review the searched papers and ask Bio Agent for specific data analysis or validation suggestions based on the evidence.
Ask Literature Agent to find additional supporting evidence for your proposed analysis. Refer to concrete datasets or mechanisms where possible.

final_instruction: As {agent_id}, provide your final summary and key recommendations for: {goal}. Incorporate insights from the real search context and discussion rounds above.
